{"metadata":{"description":"A native account-pool and provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness — Codex, Antigravity, Grok, Claude, Cursor, WorkBuddy, Command Code, Hermes and OpenRouter Free, on macOS and Windows.dsh-plugin","id":"gh:1335490343","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dockyard-dsh","slug":"AITabby/dockyard-dsh","topics":["account-pool","antigravity","codex","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","macos","oauth","windows"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A native account-pool and provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness — Codex, Antigravity, Grok, Claude, C"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ursor, WorkBuddy, Command Code, Hermes and OpenRouter Free, on macOS and Windows.dsh-plugin"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Dockyard DSH"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A native account-pool and provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 · English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Developer preview · 插件版本 **0.1.21** · macOS 与 Windows 均已验证 · Provider 逻辑全部留在各 provider 模块里"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 中文"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 这是什么"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Dockyard DSH 把多个官方 OAuth 授权和官方客户端会话接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供**一个共享的账号池、模型目录、额度视图和 provider-native 请求链路*"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"*。它是 DSH 的原生 bundle/plugin：不需要另起代理网关，也不把 provider 逻辑写进 DSH 核心。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 支持的 provider"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Provider | 账号来源 | 请求链路 |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 关键能力"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **统一账号池**：五种策略——手动选择、会话粘性、轮询、故障转移、**额度最充足优先**（按各账号最紧窗口的剩余比例选号，无额度数据时回落轮询）。
- **失效账号不丢弃**：授权过期后进入冷却"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"（默认 30 分钟），冷却结束自动重试刷新，成功即重新进入可用池。
- **按账号的模型目录**：Antigravity 等 provider 的模型表随账号不同（同一 provider 的付费档和免"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"费档看到的模型就不一样），目录按账号分别缓存与展示。
- **额度是活的**：窗口剩余 ≤15% 时提示偏低；**6 小时内要重置却还剩 ≥50%** 时提醒（这条最容易白白浪费）；provider "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"上报余额时一并显示。
- **面板不打扰**：模型列表默认折叠、点开才读取一次；后台只静默刷新额度数字，不把面板切成加载态。
- 所有命令、模型选择和生成共用同一个 runtime，不存在第二套账号池"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"并显示。
- **面板不打扰**：模型列表默认折叠、点开才读取一次；后台只静默刷新额度数字，不把面板切成加载态。
- 所有命令、模型选择和生成共用同一个 runtime，不存在第二套账号池或额度缓存。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 凭据与安全"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- 原始 OAuth token / secret 不进入 Git、账号池快照或页面状态；运行时只传递 opaque credential reference。
- refresh token 存在安"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"全凭据存储里，重启后自动续期；只有 provider 撤销或改变协议时才需要重新授权。
- macOS 默认 Keychain；Windows 走宿主 Credentials 服务。宿主没有该服务时 "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"fail closed，不退回不安全的内存存储。
- 额度、模型、套餐、身份、过期时间都来自 provider 的实时结果；provider 不返回就保持 `unknown`/`null`。
- 提 "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"issue 前请读 `SECURITY.md`，不要提交 token、OAuth 文件、Keychain 值或含敏感信息的日志。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 已知限制"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- DSH 本身仍是 developer preview，上游可能有 breaking changes。
- provider 的 CLI、客户端路径、OAuth 返回字段和额度接口都可能变；缺失字段"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"保持未知，不做猜测。
- 浏览器多账号依赖 provider 官方授权页与 token response；对方改了流程就需要重新验证，而不是猜协议。
- Windows 上的本机会话扫描不可用。
- "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"**首字延迟主要不在插件**：实测直连上游首包约 2.8s，经插件约 2.6s（预热后几乎不额外增加）。界面上更长的等待通常来自 DSH 侧的上下文组装，以及切换模型后该模型的提示缓存需要重建；长会话"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"定期开新会话、减少切换模型都能明显改善。"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### What it is"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Dockyard DSH connects official OAuth authorizations and official client sessions to one shared accou"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"nt pool, model catalog, quota view, and provider-native request path inside DeepSeek Harness. It is "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"a native DSH bundle/plugin: no side-car gateway, and no provider logic pushed into the DSH core."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### What you get"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **One account pool, five policies**: manual, sticky session, round robin, failover, and **most all"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"owance left** — which picks the account with the largest remaining share of its tightest window, fal"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ling back to round robin when nothing reports quota.
- **Expired accounts are parked, not dropped**:"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" they get a cooldown (30 minutes by default) and are retried automatically, returning to the pool as"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" soon as a refresh succeeds.
- **Per-account model catalogs**: providers such as Antigravity expose "},{"id":"p21s6","text":"different models per account (a paid tier and a free tier see different lists), so discovery and cac"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"hing are account-scoped.
- **Live quota awareness**: a window below 15% is flagged low, and a window"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" that **resets within 6 hours while at least 50% unused** is flagged as about to be wasted. A report"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"ed balance is shown alongside.
- **A panel that stays out of the way**: the model list is collapsed "},{"id":"p21s10","text":"and read once when opened; background polls refresh only the quota numbers instead of flipping the p"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"anel into a loading state.
- Commands, model selection, and generation all read the same runtime — t"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"here is no second pool or quota cache."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Credentials and security"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- Raw OAuth tokens and secrets are not stored in Git, account-pool snapshots, or page state; the run"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"time passes opaque credential references.
- Refresh tokens live in secure credential storage and ren"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ew access tokens after a restart; only provider revocation or protocol changes require reauthorizati"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"on.
- macOS uses the Keychain; Windows delegates to the host Credentials service. Without that servi"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ce the plugin fails closed instead of falling back to an unsafe in-memory store.
- Models, plans, qu"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"otas, identities, and expiry come from live provider responses; missing values stay `unknown`/`null`"},{"id":"p23s7","text":".
- Read `SECURITY.md` before filing issues. Never commit tokens, OAuth files, Keychain values, or s"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"RITY.md` before filing issues. Never commit tokens, OAuth files, Keychain values, or sensitive logs."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness is still a developer preview and may introduce breaking changes.
- Provider CLIs,"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" desktop paths, OAuth fields, and quota APIs can change; missing fields stay unknown rather than gue"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ssed.
- Multi-account browser flows depend on each provider's official authorization page and token "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"response; a changed flow has to be re-verified, not guessed.
- On Windows, local session scanning is"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" unavailable.
- **Time to first token is mostly not the plugin**: a direct upstream call starts stre"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"aming in about 2.8s, and through the plugin in about 2.6s once warm. Longer waits in the UI usually "},{"id":"p25s7","text":"come from DSH assembling the context, plus the prompt cache being rebuilt after a model switch; star"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"ting a fresh session and switching models less often both help."}],"truncated":true}
